players.bio: Adama Boiro Boiro is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club West Ham United, on loan from La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Aitor Paredes Casamichana (born 29 April 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team.
Alejandro Rego Mora (born 11 June 2003) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Athletic Bilbao.

Alejandro "Álex" Berenguer Remiro (born 4 July 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Athletic Bilbao. He began his career at Osasuna in 2014, and played in Italy with Torino for three seasons before joining Athletic in 2020.
Alejandro "Álex" Padilla Pérez (born 1 September 2003) is a footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao. Born in Spain, he plays for the Mexico national under-23 team.

Álvaro Djaló Dias-Fernandes (born 16 August 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Qatar Stars League Al-Gharafa on loan from La Liga club Athletic Bilbao. Born in Spain, he represents the Guinea-Bissau national team.

Aymeric Jean Louis Gérard Alphonse Laporte (French pronunciation: ; born 27 May 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao. Born in France, he plays for the Spain national team.
Beñat Gerenabarrena Zendoia (born 29 March 2003) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Athletic Bilbao.
Beñat Prados Díaz (born 8 February 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Athletic Bilbao.
Daniel "Dani" Vivian Moreno (born 5 July 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team.
Gorka Guruzeta Rodríguez (born 12 September 1996) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Hugo Rincón Lumbreras (born 27 January 2003) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.

Iñaki Williams Arthuer (born 15 June 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for and captains La Liga club Athletic Bilbao. Developed at Athletic Bilbao's academy, he has made over 500 first-team appearances for the club, including a La Liga record of 251 consecutive matches. He scored the winning goal of the 2020–21 Supercopa de España, and also won the 2023–24 Copa del Rey.
Iñigo Lekue Martínez (Basque: ; Spanish: ; born 4 May 1993) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Athletic Bilbao mainly as a right-back.
Iñigo Ruiz de Galarreta Etxeberria (born 6 August 1993) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Jesús Areso Blanco (born 2 July 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Johaneko Louis-Jean (born 28 June 2004) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back or left-back for Spanish club Athletic Bilbao.
Maroan Sannadi Harrouch (born 1 February 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Athletic Bilbao.
Mikel Jauregizar Alboniga (born 13 November 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Athletic Bilbao.
Nicolás "Nico" Serrano Galdeano (born 5 March 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Athletic Bilbao.

Nicholas Williams Arthuer (born 12 July 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team. He is recognised for his speed and dribbling skills.
Oihan Sancet Tirapu (born 25 April 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Athletic Bilbao as a central midfielder.
Peio Canales Urtasun (born 17 January 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Roberto Navarro Muñoz (born 12 April 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Athletic Bilbao.
Unai Egiluz Arroyo (born 19 March 2002) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a centre-back for CD Mirandés, on loan from Athletic Bilbao.

Unai Simón Mendibil (born 11 June 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao and the Spain national team. Simón has spent his entire club career with Athletic, developing with their youth academy, farm team and reserves and making his senior debut in 2018, amassing 200 appearances by 2025.
Unai Vencedor Paris (born 15 November 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Levante UD, on loan from Athletic Bilbao.

Yeray Álvarez López (Spanish pronunciation: [ɟʝeˈɾaj ˈalβaɾeθ]; born 24 January 1995), known simply as Yeray, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Athletic Bilbao.
Yuri Berchiche Izeta (born 10 February 1990) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Athletic Bilbao as a left-back.
